Hi Michael / Samantha —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from my side and a proposed set of next steps so we keep momentum:

Summary of discovery:
- Primary use case: real-time clinical note generation + embeddings for similarity search across patient records.
- Peak throughput target: ~120 reqs/sec with p95 latency < 300ms.
- Data constraints: PHI in payloads; strong preference for customer-controlled network boundary / KMS.

Why we flagged Dedicated / On-prem (VPC) as an option:
- Dedicated GPU pools give predictable throughput and easier compliance posture for PHI workloads.
- Private deployments (VPC or on-prem) allow you to control networking and KMS/HSM keys, which aligns with your security needs.

Mutual action plan (proposed):
1) Confirm priority/timing for deployment (pilot Q1 vs POC in Q2) — you
2) Intro ops/security session with Monica + Aditya to walk network diagrams and KMS flow (20–30m) — we can schedule next week
3) Provide preliminary sizing and committed capacity estimate from our side (we'll share a one-pager)
4) Procurement: we can share redlined T&Cs and an initial SOW once scope is agreed

Attachments: 20261201-dedicated-vs-onprem-onepager.pdf (brief sizing + tradeoffs).

Ask: can you confirm if dedicated/VPC is something you want to prioritize for your PHI pilot, and if so, what timing window (Jan/Feb/Mar)? If not, we can focus on hosted with hardened network paths while you finalize compliance.

Happy to hop on a quick call to align — Monica and Aditya are copied for scheduling.

Thanks,
